reviews.text:
Around 7 PM, my dog ​​had loose, red stools, so I called my usual vet. I think it was because it was late, but the phone call I received gave off a "don't come" vibe. 💦 I urgently contacted this hospital, and they were incredibly kind and helpful.

Even though it was so late, everyone was so kind and helpful. Thank you so much! 😊
The explanations were also very thorough and easy to understand. ✨

It was a great hospital, just as the reviews said. 
They were polite and caring.

My cat was in pain in her lower body, and after a few days I couldn't hold her anymore. Her body had become distorted from compensating for the pain, so I came here.

As others have written in their reviews,
the doctor and assistant were very kind and
treated my cat as if she were their own.

They calmly and gently spoke to my cat, who was groaning and moving violently in pain.

They gave her a painkiller injection, and after returning home, her distorted body was a little better,
and she didn't seem to be in pain, which was a relief.

I hope she doesn't experience any further pain, but if anything happens, I would like to use this hospital again in the future.

While waiting at the reception, I overheard someone saying they had been using this hospital for about 30 years. It's a truly trustworthy animal hospital.

My cat's ear infection had worsened, and I was looking for a veterinary clinic when I came across this one with very good reviews and decided to give it a try. The doctor and staff were all very nice, and I had a very positive impression of the clinic. The examination was very thorough, and the doctor was kind. I had only planned to have my cat's ears and bottom checked, but they even trimmed her claws, which was a great help. I would definitely like to use their services again if my cat has any health problems. Thank you very much.

This was my first visit. The doctor was very kind and treated my dog ​​as if it were his own. The female assistant was also smiling and kind throughout. The fees are reasonable, and it's a very conscientious hospital.
